<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="ex1908202302281313" type="excerpt" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon" part="M" next="ex019082025-11-1014-32-59"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (32b3-32b7)"/>
            <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4610"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3724"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3715">dbu ma rtsa ba</rs>'i 'grel pa tshig gsal ba</rs>'i bshad pa nges don rnaM par gzigs pa</rs> zhes bya ba 'di la tshig gi <expan>'bras bu</expan> bshad pa dang ¦ gzhung ngag don du 'chad pa dang ¦ khyad par gyi <lb n="32b4"/> gzhi bsdus te 'them sbyor du bshad pa dang × ngag don gyis mtshams sbyar te gzhung rtags sbyor gyi khongs su bsdus te bshad pa dang | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3715">rtsa ba mdo</rs> dang <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5826">dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos</rs> dang | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:7338">de 'chad byed kyi Ti ka</rs> rnams dgongs pa cig tu ston pas thub pa'i bstan pa'i yan lag tu 'brel par 'chad pas | 'chad pa po gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa 'di ni thub pa'i chos kyi 'khor <lb n="32b5"/> lo rim gsuM bskor nas lnga brgya phrag bdun pas lhag pa na | <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4326">ma ga da rdo rje'i gdan pa</rs>s byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgya bsgrod pa'i gnas su shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa byang phyogs su dar par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa ltar grub pa na lung dang rigs pa'i de kho na nyid khong du chud nas smra ba <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4608">shag kya'i dge slong shes rab 'buM</rs> gyis <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5572">brag raM gyi gtsug lag khang</rs> du sbyar <lb n="32b6"/> ba'o || </seg></TEI>
source: 1_019_08 dbu ma rtsa ba’i ’grel pa tshig gsal gyi bshad pa nges don rnam par gzigs pa.xml
